thread:
ops-bot: [INCIDENT P1] High rate of CUDA OOMs on decode fleet in us-west-2; auto-restart churn detected, ~18 pods in last 10m. Possible runaway streaming. Paging oncall.
alex: paging @jordan (oncall) — seeing >50% decode drops and 502s for customer 'BrightChat'. logs attached in the incident tracker. :exclamation:
jordan: on it, hitting the node group dashboard. Can someone dump recent decode logs? kevin, can you check model routing? emily, triage customer impact with support.
kevin: checking routing + rollout history. No recent model pushes in the last 2h. There's a sudden spike from route /v1/generate/stream with long content-length values.
emily: support says BrightChat reports a 45% failure rate for streaming responses starting ~15:12 UTC (matching alerts). They escalated to CSM. I'm drafting a customer-facing note.
jordan: grabbing logs now. snippet:
```
E 15:18:12 cudaOutOfMemory: failed to allocate 1200000000 bytes
W 15:18:12 pid=dec-7 container restart
E 15:18:13 runtime: decode loop exceeded max-kv-cache, aborting
```
jordan: root cause hypothesis: runaway generation / max_tokens overflow from client side. One request set max_tokens to 50000 (client unit mismatch) — streaming decoder tries to allocate KV cache ramping until OOM.
kevin: confirmed a cluster of long-lived streams from one IP block hitting the high-capacity GPUs. Rate-limited but not bounded per-request. We need an emergency per-request token cap at the proxy.
alex: ops proposal: 1) apply proxy-level max_tokens=2048 cap immediately 2) enable fast-shed for streams > 60s 3) spin up additional small-model pool and route non-critical traffic to it.
jordan: running emergency cmd to patch envoy route limiter:
```
kubectl -n redwood exec svc/proxy-rolling -c envoy -- envoyctl set-request-limit --max-tokens=2048
```
jordan: patched. Rolling window enforced. Also issuing a temporary policy to reject single-request token > 8000 with 400 response.
kevin: started traffic shift to smaller model variants: route /v1/generate -> model-small-1 for non-enterprise orgs. Hooked autoscaler to add two nodes to decode-small pool.
emily: customer update sent: "We're investigating elevated errors; we've applied temporary throttles to stabilize platform and are working on targeted mitigation. We'll follow up in 30m." CSM wants ETA.
kiran: from sales ops: flagged for priority support. If BrightChat is on a committed plan, we might credit usage. Keep me in loop.
jordan: mitigation immediate effects visible — OOMs dropping from ~12/min to ~1/min. Pod churn stopped. However some requests still dropped during restarts; total dropped ~3k requests in the window. Marking customer impact as partial degraded for BrightChat.
kevin: follow-up: found a malformed client bug — they were passing tokens in characters, not tokens, due to SDK v0.9 mismatch. We're adding a server-side validation to coerce/limit unhappy clients.
alex: next steps: 1) follow-up patch to runtime to early-abort streams hitting KV growth patterns 2) permanent proxy limit + quota for per-org max_tokens 3) post-incident runbook updates 4) support/sales outreach + credit proposal
jordan: creating the incident page now: https://redwood.incidents/2468001234
sre_bot: incident created: https://redwood.incidents/2468001234 — severity: P1, commander: jordan, timeline: in progress
emily: customer update scheduled at 16:00 UTC. I'll include drop counts and mitigation steps and offer a 10% usage credit pending product approval.
kevin: filing PR for server-side validation and early-kv abort: PR #4892, linking here.
alex: handing off to next oncall @jordan -> @kevin at 16:30 UTC. kevin, you'll own postmortem and coordinating with infra for autoscaler tweak.
jordan: handing off. current status: throttles live, traffic shift active, OOMs minimized, customer notified. next oncall please monitor for 2h and confirm no recurrence.
kevin: ack. I'll take over and keep sales/support in the loop. Logging timeline and root-cause for postmortem. +1 on credits if central team approves.
ops-bot: automated note: alert suppression in place for this cluster; monitoring will resume normal alerting at 17:00 UTC.
kiran: thx team. Once postmortem draft is ready, ping me for customer comms and PR approval. :thumbsup:
